title: Discussion and possible motion to reconsider CFAC's August 6, 2026 action regarding the
text:
[OLD BUSINESS - DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTIONS]
Discussion and possible motion to reconsider CFAC's August 6, 2026 action regarding the
proposed comment letter on Council File 26-0757 (City Plants); and, if reconsideration is approved,
consideration, amendment, and possible approval of a revised CFAC comment letter regarding sustainable
funding and program recommendations for City Plants. Draft of proposed revised letter: CFAC CIS CF
26-0757 Updated (Theresa Maysonet) (5 minutes)
summary: Discussion and possible motion to reconsider and revise the CFAC's previous comment letter on City Plants, focusing on sustainable funding and program recommendations.
